scripts.deploy: npm run git:add && npm run git:commit && npm run git:push
scripts.db:migrate: C:\sqlite\sqlite3.exe db\database.sqlite ".read db/migrations/000_core_auth.sql" && C:\sqlite\sqlite3.exe db\database.sqlite ".read db/migrations/001_skills.sql" && C:\sqlite\sqlite3.exe db\database.sqlite ".read db/migrations/001a_hero_training.sql"
scripts.db:seed: C:\sqlite\sqlite3.exe db\database.sqlite ".read db/seeds/001_skill_maps.sql" && C:\sqlite\sqlite3.exe db\database.sqlite ".read db/seeds/002_skill_curves.sql" && C:\sqlite\sqlite3.exe db\database.sqlite ".read db/seeds/003_class_skill_rates.sql"
scripts.db:verify: C:\sqlite\sqlite3.exe db\database.sqlite "SELECT 'heroes_master' as t, COUNT(*) FROM heroes_master; SELECT 'player_heroes', COUNT(*) FROM player_heroes; SELECT 'weapon_skill_map', COUNT(*) FROM weapon_skill_map; SELECT 'skill_curves', COUNT(*) FROM skill_curves; SELECT 'class_skill_rates', COUNT(*) FROM class_skill_rates;"
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:drop && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
